note.name: ether.fi
note.thesis: ETHFI trades at 26.4x annualised revenue versus an 11.1x peer median, with new Core Contributor supply starting 6 Nov. Price is weak and the buyback does not shrink float. Positioning is not crowded, which limits squeeze risk but does not fix valuation.
note.what: ETHFI is the governance token of ether.fi, a crypto app offering ETH staking through eETH/weETH, automated yield vaults, a Visa card called Cash and Markets trading. Users stake ETH, spend via the card and borrow against crypto; ETHFI is used for votes and app membership perks.

points.text: ETHFI trades at 26.4x annualised revenue; the peer median is 11.1x. Its fees multiple is not shown, so the revenue premium is the clearest valuation fact.
30-day fees annualise to $125.78M and 7-day fees to $154.49M. Revenue is $22.89M annualised, so most fees pass through rather than accrue to the protocol.
981.4M of 1.000B is unlocked. The next 90 days add 13.1M ETHFI, 1.3% of circulating supply, all Core Contributors, starting 6 Nov 2026.
Through 18 Oct 2026, 1.83M ETHFI was paid out over six weeks; 1.28M, or 70%, left Cash accounts and only 548k was retained.
DefiLlama's staking listings exclude Cash card income, so the 26.4x revenue multiple may overstate the expense of the business if the card is material.

note.supplyHeadline: Modest scheduled unlocks, disputed larger figure
note.supplyText: DefiLlama shows 981.4M of 1.000B unlocked. The next 90 days add 13.1M ETHFI, 1.3% of CoinGecko circulating supply, all Core Contributors, starting 6 Nov 2026. Linear vesting is 1.0M/week to 14 Mar 2027, with no cliffs. CoinGecko circulating is 998.5M, so exact float is uncertain. A reported 44.8M remaining figure is disputed.
note.valuationText: Fees are what users pay; revenue is what ether.fi keeps. ETHFI's FDV is 26.4x annualised revenue versus an 11.1x peer median. Its FDV/annualised fees multiple is not shown. Revenue matters more than fees here because fees largely pass through; card income is excluded from the comparison.
note.usageText: 30-day fees are $10.34M, annualising to $125.78M; 7-day fees annualise to $154.49M. Revenue is $1.88M over 30 days, or $22.89M annualised. DefiLlama excludes card income, so usage may be understated if Cash is material.

catalysts.text: Core Contributor vesting begins; 1.0M ETHFI per week through 14 Mar 2027.

risks.title: Card revenue disclosed
risks.text: A dated disclosure showing material, profitable Cash card revenue would undercut the revenue-premium bear case.

risks.title: Buyback accelerates
risks.text: Buyback contributions above $225k/week, if confirmed, would absorb more supply than the current schedule.

risks.title: Short crowding unwinds
risks.text: Long/short account ratio at 0.68 means few accounts are long; a shift could squeeze the bearish price trend.

risks.title: Unlock overhang smaller
risks.text: If the disputed 44.8M figure is wrong and only 13.1M unlocks in 90 days, supply pressure is limited.

watchlist.item: 44.8M ETHFI remaining and 8.9M unlock on 15 Nov 2026
Market-maker loans of about 11M ETHFI; renewal unconfirmed
Card revenue profitability and dated disclosure

note.positioningText: Funding is +0.0100%/8h now and on a 7-day average, so longs pay shorts. Open interest is $20M, down 1.0% over seven days. The long/short account ratio is 0.68, with 40% of accounts long: positioning is not crowded long.
note.conclusion: ETHFI is expensive on revenue versus its peer median, the buyback does not reduce float, and Core Contributor vesting starts on 6 Nov. The price trend is weak. The main offset is that DefiLlama excludes card income, which could make the revenue multiple look worse than the business is. Positioning is not crowded long.
note.invalidation: Card revenue disclosed and buyback contributions exceed $225k/week for two consecutive weeks.
note.gaps: No 90-day fees or revenue; no card revenue in DefiLlama; no primary team, foundation or investor sale data; no quantified emissions or points-farming split; buyback dashboard not primary; unlock schedule disputed; no confirmed governance, listing or equity earnings event in the next eight weeks.
